paper_title: First search for ultralight dark matter with a space-based gravitational-wave antenna: LISA Pathfinder
coupling_convention: epsilon^2_95% as plotted on y-axis: SQUARED coupling strength of dark photon to baryons (dimensionless, 95% CL upper limit). NOT converted to linear epsilon/chi.
notes: First search for dark photon dark matter coupled to baryons (U(1)_B) using LISA Pathfinder data, covering masses [8e-20, 2e-14] eV (frequencies [2e-5, 5] Hz). Genuine new observed 95% CL upper limits on eps^2 are presented, but ONLY in Figure 5 - no numerical values or tables are given in the text, so no data points could be extracted. Note the coupling is to baryon number (U(1)_B), which the paper distinguishes from kinetic mixing; if downstream requires U(1)_B specifically rather than kinetic mixing chi, this may need a separate category. VectorBL was considered but the paper constrains baryon coupling, with B-L only mentioned as an alternative model. Digitization of Figure 5 would be needed to obtain the limit curve. | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of the fully-coherent low-frequency (red, m < ~4e-18 eV) and fully-coherent high-frequency (black, m > ~4e-18 eV) 95% CL upper-limit bands; semi-coherent (magenta) limits') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: Figure 5 of the paper (data segment starting 14 Feb 2017). Boundary traced as the lower envelope of the fully-coherent low-frequency (red, m < ~4e-18 eV) and fully-coherent high-frequency (black, m > ~4e-18 eV) 95% CL upper-limit bands; semi-coherent (magenta) limits lie above except at highest masses where the smooth magenta curve dips below the black band (~1.5e-14 to 2e-14 eV, ~1e-23). Both bands are very noisy (spikes span ~2-4 decades); values represent the approximate lower edge/median. IMPORTANT: plotted quantity is epsilon^2 (squared coupling), emitted as plotted per contract. The paper constrains a dark photon coupled to BARYONS (U(1)_B-type charge on test masses), reported as coupling strength epsilon^2 rather than pure kinetic mixing chi; coupling type set to DarkPhoton per text-analysis hint, but VectorBL-like interpretation possible, hence moderate confidence.
